content.title: Is Santa Rosa, California a Good Place to Live? 7 Things you MUST Know!
content.text: 🌲 Is Santa Rosa, CA the right place for you? Let’s break it down! 🏡 If you’re thinking about moving to Santa Rosa, California, you’ve probably asked: ➡️ Is Santa Rosa a good place to live? ➡️ What are the pros and cons of living here? ➡️ Is it worth moving from the Bay Area or out of state? In this video, I’ll cover everything you need to know before relocating, including: 🏡 Cost of Living – How expensive is Santa Rosa compared to the rest of California? 📍 Best Neighborhoods – Where should you live? (Bennett Valley, Fountaingrove & more) 💼 Job Market & Economy – Is Santa Rosa good for work or remote jobs? 🚗 Traffic & Commuting – How bad is the Highway 101 commute? Does the SMART Train help? ☀️ Lifestyle & Outdoor Activities – What’s there to do in Santa Rosa? 📚 Schools & Education – Are the schools in Santa Rosa any good? 💰 Hidden Costs – Fire insurance, gas prices, utility bills & other expenses to watch for! 📩 Moving to Santa Rosa?
